text: Quick smoke test that it boots without a DSN:

input.description: Boot the server briefly to check startup

text:
Error tracking is in. The server starts cleanly with no DSN set (exit 124 is just my 4-second timeout killing it). I haven't sent a test event, so reports reaching GlitchTip are unverified.

GBrain says the team self-hosts GlitchTip at `https://errors.larkfield.example` and rejected Sentry's hosted service on 2026-10-28 because of event volume cost. So I used the Sentry-compatible `@sentry/node` SDK and pointed it at GlitchTip. It reads the DSN from `GLITCHTIP_DSN`, as the decision log specifies.

- **`src/instrument.js`** (new): initializes the SDK with `GLITCHTIP_DSN` and sets the environment from `NODE_ENV`. Performance tracing is off, since GlitchTip is only for errors. With no DSN it does nothing, so local development is unaffected.
- **`package.json`**: added `@sentry/node`, and `npm start` now preloads the instrumentation with `node --import ./src/instrument.js src/server.js`.
- **`src/server.js`**: added `Sentry.setupExpressErrorHandler(app)` after the routes. Express 5 passes rejected async handlers to it, so a failed Postgres query in `/households/:id/lists` gets reported.
- **`README.md`**: a short note on the setup.

To turn it on, set `GLITCHTIP_DSN` in staging and production. You can then confirm it by throwing a test error from a route and checking GlitchTip.

Errors outside request handling, like uncaught exceptions and unhandled rejections, are reported by the SDK's default handlers. I didn't test those either.
